name: Standards

subjectOf.text: The electrical revolution took more than a century to mature because uniform standards for production, transmission, storage, and utilization had to be developed first, and decentralization faces the same standards bottleneck.
subjectOf.abstract: This is similar to the electrical revolution that took more than a century to come to fruition, because of the need to develop uniform standards for production, trans- mission, storage, and utilization.
subjectOf.citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, Eight Institutions for the Evolution of Decentralization (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3782205
scope_conditions: analogical argument from the history of electrification

subjectOf.text: Without standards for digital assets it will be very difficult to increase regulatory certainty or coordinate market activity, and without regulatory certainty the digital asset market is less likely to evolve.
subjectOf.abstract: Without standards for digital assets, it will be very difficult to increase regulatory certainty in the digital asset space and coordinate market activity. Without regulatory certainty the market for digital assets is less likely to evolve.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Reputation as Capital – How DAOs Upgrade Finance (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3949098
scope_conditions: digital asset markets seeking mass adoption

subjectOf.text: The rule that no tokens may be distributed to insiders such as team, founders, associated whales, core investors, advisors, and marketing teams before or after the token sale is the most important staple of fair launch doctrine and cannot be subject to exceptions; any exception should cost the project the fair token launch designation.
subjectOf.abstract: This rule is perhaps the most important key staple of the fair launch doctrine and cannot be subject to exceptions. Any exceptions to this rule should result in the loss of the designation fair token launch.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Fair Token Launch (2022). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4015908
scope_conditions: projects claiming the fair token launch designation

subjectOf.text: Through fair launch evolution and continuous practice improvements, the fair launch industry and the underlying digital asset businesses can become the foundation of the emerging decentralized digital asset economy.
subjectOf.abstract: Through fair launch evolution and continuous practice improvements, the fair launch industry and underlying digital asset businesses can become the foundation of the emerging decentralized digital asset economy.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Fair Token Launch (2022). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4015908
scope_conditions: continued evolution and improvement of fair launch practice

subjectOf.text: As of 2022 there is no agreed upon reliable valuation method for cryptocurrencies.
subjectOf.abstract: An agreed-upon reliable valuation method does not exist for cryptocurrencies in 2022.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Samuel Evans, Hayley Howe, Digital Asset Valuation (2022). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4033886

subjectOf.text: Aggregating reviews into a public compendium generates a common standard for code reviews that legacy review environments lack, and a shared standard aligns reviewer and collective expectations about functionality and quality outcomes.
subjectOf.abstract: The CRDAO creates a compendium of reviews and through it a common standard for code reviews that are otherwise lacking in legacy code review environments.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Code Review DAO (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4734750

subjectOf.text: The absence of interoperability considerations with non standardized networks restricts the utility of exchange based monitoring in a fragmented and continuously evolving DeFi landscape.
subjectOf.abstract: absence of interoperability considerations with non-standardized networks further restricts its utility in a fragmented ever evolving DeFi landscape.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, How can we Best Monitor AI Agents (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5245185
scope_conditions: fragmented DeFi environment with non standardized networks

subjectOf.text: The Codex must be technology neutral and globally consistent, meaning its rules are drafted to function across legal jurisdictions and across technological platforms rather than being tied to any one of them.
subjectOf.abstract: ▪ Technology-neutral and globally consistent, designed to function across legal jurisdictions and technological platforms;
subjectOf.citation: Furrer Andreas, Wulf A. Kaal, Stephan D. Meyer, Universal Digital Law Codex (UDLC) (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5886342
